summary: Light smoke regression after (a) switching iOS/Android package identifiers from `com.emergent.swasthdaily.g2rsso` -> `com.swasthdaily.app` and (b) re-adding `expo.android.googleServicesFile: ./google-services.json`. All 4 verification pillars pass: (1) File presence — google-services.json exists (679 bytes), valid JSON, contains project_info+client+api_key+oauth_client, no `type: service_account`, no `private_key`, registered package_name matches `com.swasthdaily.app` (project_id=online-vaidyaji). (2) app.json valid JSON; both ios.bundleIdentifier and android.package == com.swasthdaily.app; googleServicesFile correctly wired. (3) Backend smoke 6/6 pass (100%) using existing /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_regression.py suite — GET /api/ (200, {message: 'Online Vaidhyaji API', version: '1.0'}), POST /api/auth/login admin (JWT), POST /api/register-push (201 status=pending with placeholder key, non-500 contract preserved), POST /api/appointments (non-blocking push), POST /api/payments/create-order Razorpay (200 with order_id), POST /api/video/session Daily.co (200 with room url). The only expo warning in logs is the known/expected `expo-notifications: Android push functionality removed from Expo Go SDK 53 — use dev build` — this is EXPECTED and non-fatal (as flagged in request: FCM push only works after native Android build with new package name). No regressions.
